dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: An n-indexed inductive type of complete run records. Through the displayed constructor D015, a record contains an n-dimensional linear system, exact and computed vectors, infinite error sequences, precision parameters, a dimension-factor polynomial, restart records, and validity and error-bound proofs.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target quantifies over every inhabitant run of this type, so the record's constructor requirements restrict the theorem's domain. Its exact domain is not fully recoverable because the constructor of the nested restart type is truncated.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.A, an n by n real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies A to the normalized residual and condition-factor expressions in both recurrences.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.b, a real vector indexed by Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the right-hand side b in the normalized residual eta(A,b,x).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.xExact, the exact solution vector in R^n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the reference vector in both relative forward-error quantities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.xHat, an infinite sequence Nat -> R^n of computed iterates.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The two conclusions compare normalized errors at xHat_i and xHat_(i+1) for every natural i.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The normalized residual eta(A,b,x) defined by LocalDef023: ||b-Ax||_2/(||A||_F ||x||_2+||b||_2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the error measure on both sides of the first recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: For iteration i, C(n,k_i) uHigh, where C is the run's dimension-factor polynomial and k_i is the restart record's key dimension.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the additive term in the normalized-residual recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: For iteration i, C(n,k_i) uHigh kappa_F, where kappa_F=||Ainv||_F ||A||_F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the additive term in the relative forward-error recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: For iteration i, lambda_i=C(n,k_i) uLow kappa_F, where kappa_F=||Ainv||_F ||A||_F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The explicit hypothesis requires 0 <= lambda_i < 1 for every i, and lambda_i multiplies the preceding error in both conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The relative forward error E(xExact,xHat)=||xHat-xExact||_2/||xExact||_2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the error measure on both sides of the second recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: The keyDimension field of a restart record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to run.restart i, it defines k_i in all three iteration-dependent coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.Ainv, an n by n real matrix intended and assumed by D015 to be a two-sided inverse of A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its Frobenius norm enters kappa_F and hence lambda_i and both forward-error additive terms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.correctionHat, an infinite sequence of computed correction vectors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in the packaged update equation and each restart record, but not explicitly in the two displayed recurrences.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.dimensionFactor, a nonnegative-coefficient bivariate polynomial record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its evaluation C(n,k_i) determines every iteration-dependent coefficient in the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: The displayed constructor of a run record. It packages n>0; A and Ainv; b and xExact; iterate, residual, correction, residual-error, and update-error sequences; uHigh,uLow>0; a dimension-factor record; b!=0; bijectivity and two-sided inverse laws; AxExact=b; residual and update models with componentwise bounds; restart records; and two aggregate normwise error bounds.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These requirements are implicit assumptions whenever run is quantified. In particular they give b!=0, xExact!=0, exact inverse relations, and the error models from which the recurrences are intended to follow.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.residualHat, an infinite sequence of computed residual vectors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in the run's residual model and restart records, but is eliminated from the displayed conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.restart, assigning to each iteration i a restart record indexed by the current and next iterates, computed residual and correction, uLow, and the dimension-factor record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its keyDimension field defines k_i. All other restart data affect only which runs inhabit LocalDef001.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.uHigh, a positive real parameter in D015.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It scales both additive terms and the packaged high-precision error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.uLow, a positive real parameter in D015.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It scales lambda_i and the low-precision restart error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: For n, the type Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Real, namely n by n real matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the dimensions and scalar field of A and Ainv.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: For n, the type Fin n -> Real, namely real n-vectors represented as coordinate functions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the type of b, xExact, all iterates, and all vector errors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Frobenius condition factor kappa_F(A,Ainv)=||Ainv||_F ||A||_F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in lambda_i and in the second recurrence's additive term. The definition uses the stored Ainv rather than computing an inverse.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: The normalized residual eta(A,b,x)=||b-Ax||_2/(||A||_F ||x||_2+||b||_2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D006 unfolds to this exact quantity in the first recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: Evaluation of a bivariate polynomial record c at natural arguments n and k: C(n,k)=sum_{p=0}^{degreeN} sum_{q=0}^{degreeK} coefficient(p,q) n^p k^q, with n and k cast to reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: C(n,k_i) is the dimension factor occurring in lambda_i and both additive terms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Euclidean vector norm ||x||_2=sqrt(sum_{j in Fin n} x_j^2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the residual and forward-error numerators and denominators and all vector norm bounds in the packaged run assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: An indexed inductive type of restart or inner-solve records depending on A,Ainv,b,xExact,current and next iterates, computed residual and correction, uLow, and a dimension-factor record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each iteration must carry such a record, and its keyDimension determines the target coefficients. The complete validity conditions cannot be recovered because its displayed constructor D036 ends in an ellipsis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: A record-like inductive type constructed in D037 from two natural degrees and a rectangular array of nonnegative real coefficients.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the bivariate polynomial C used to scale all target coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: The coefficient array of a dimension-factor record, indexed by Fin(degreeN+1) and Fin(degreeK+1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These coefficients are summed in C(n,k); their constructor assumption makes every coefficient nonnegative.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: The degreeK field of a dimension-factor polynomial record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the upper range of powers of k in C(n,k).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: The degreeN field of a dimension-factor polynomial record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the upper range of powers of n in C(n,k).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real function gamma_n(u)=n*u/(1-n*u), with n cast to a real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in componentwise residual-error and modified Gram-Schmidt projection-error assumptions inside valid runs, but not in the displayed conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Frobenius norm of an n by n real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines ||A||_F, ||Ainv||_F, the normalized-residual denominator, and kappa_F.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that the matrix-vector map x -> Ax is bijective.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is an implicit validity assumption carried by every run constructed through D015.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix-vector multiplication: (Ax)_i=sum_{j in Fin n} A_ij x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines residuals, the equation AxExact=b, inverse identities, and several packaged error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: The residual vector r(A,b,x)=b-Ax.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its Euclidean norm is the numerator of eta, and it occurs in the computed-residual model.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: The displayed constructor of a restart record. Its visible portion requires 0<keyDimension<=n and packages Arnoldi, modified Gram-Schmidt, residual-casting, least-squares, and correction-formation data with exact relations and normwise error bounds, followed by positive lower-gain data. The declaration is truncated immediately after the basis lower-gain hypothesis.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts each restart and in particular bounds k_i between 1 and n. The omitted tail prevents an exact account of all additional restrictions and of the use of imageLowerGain and other deep dependencies.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: A constructor producing a dimension-factor record from degrees degreeN and degreeK, a coefficient array, and proofs that every coefficient is nonnegative.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures C(n,k)>=0 for natural n and k.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: For m and k, the type Matrix (Fin m) (Fin k) Real of m by k real matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It types the basis, Hessenberg, Arnoldi, and least-squares matrices inside restart validity; it does not occur directly in the target inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: The augmented n by (k+1) matrix whose first column is phi*b and whose remaining columns are those of C.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is reachable only through restart-level conditions, apparently in the omitted part of D036, and has no direct occurrence in the target recurrences.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: Column selection from augmented data [rhs | C]: index 0 returns rhs, while index q+1 returns column q of C.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the displayed columnwise least-squares perturbation bounds inside each restart.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that y is a Euclidean least-squares minimizer for Ay approximately equal to b: for every z, ||b-Ay||_2 <= ||b-Az||_2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constrains the low-precision least-squares vector within each restart but does not occur directly in either conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: A lower-gain bound for a matrix A: for every x, sigma*||x||_2 <= ||Ax||_2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The visible part of D036 requires this for the restart basis with a positive basisLowerGain; further uses after the ellipsis are unknown.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: A near-null witness property: there exists a vector x, depending on A and delta, such that ||x||_2=1 and ||Ax||_2<=delta.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its existential witness is local to restart-level validity and never appears in the target conclusions. Its exact instantiation lies in the omitted portion of D036.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Frobenius norm of a rectangular real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in Arnoldi and correction-formation bounds inside restart records, not directly in the two recurrences.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: Rectangular matrix-vector multiplication: (Ax)_i=sum_j A_ij x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines least-squares residuals, basis times coefficient vectors, and lower-gain properties within restart records.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: Multiplication of an n by n matrix A with an n by k matrix B: (AB)_ij=sum_q A_iq B_qj.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the exact Arnoldi product A*basis in restart validity.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires both bounds in 0<=lambda_i<1 and requires both universally quantified recurrences simultaneously.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes natural addition in i+1 and real addition in each recurrence and in underlying definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes ordinary real multiplication in lambda_i, kappa_F, and the additive terms.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched non-strict order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it expresses 0<=lambda_i and the two recurrence inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched strict order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it expresses lambda_i<1 and, inside run constructors, positivity assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural numbers, including zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type of n, iteration indices i, polynomial degrees, and restart dimensions.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interpretation of a natural-number literal in a target type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real constants 0 and 1 and the natural increment 1.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: The mechanism interpreting the literal 1 from a type's multiplicative-one operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real upper bound 1 in lambda_i<1.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All scalar values, norms, coefficients, and inequalities in the target are real.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary addition on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the sums on the right-hand sides of the recurrences and in all real-valued definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual non-strict order on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the mathematical meaning of every <= relation in the target.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual strict order on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the mathematical meaning of lambda_i<1.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets all products defining lambda_i, kappa_F, and additive error terms.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real number 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the strict upper endpoint in the contraction hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real number 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the lower endpoint in the nonnegativity hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: The mechanism interpreting the literal 0 from a type's zero operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real zero in 0<=lambda_i.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary addition on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets i+1 and degree-plus-one index sizes.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-addition adapter induced by an Add instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes HAdd expressions to ordinary natural or real addition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-multiplication adapter induced by a Mul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes HMul expressions to ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical interpretation of a natural literal as itself.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the natural increment 1 in i+1.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The division operation supplied by a DivInvMonoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It underlies real division in normalized residuals, relative forward errors, and gamma_n(u).

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite index type {0,...,n-1}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes vector coordinates, matrix rows and columns, polynomial coefficients, and finite sums.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched division.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes real division in eta, relative forward error, gamma_n, and packaged normwise bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes subtraction in b-Ax, xHat-xExact, and denominator 1-n*u.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise subtraction of functions or vectors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes vector differences such as b-Ax and xHat-xExact coordinatewise.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard real multiplication, inverse, and division structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the ordinary Lean real-division operation, which is total even when the denominator is zero.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real subtraction, defined as addition of the negative.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets coordinatewise residuals and errors and the expression 1-n*u.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-division adapter induced by a Div instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes HDiv expressions to ordinary real division.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-subtraction adapter induced by a Sub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes HSub expressions to ordinary real or pointwise vector subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It states the exact equations packaged into runs and restart records; it does not occur explicitly in the final inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite enumeration structure on Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits sums over all vector and matrix indices in norms, products, and polynomial evaluation.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.val
dependency_coverage.meaning: The underlying natural value of a finite index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies polynomial exponents and natural comparisons and steps in restart-level formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: Finite summation in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines Euclidean and Frobenius norms, matrix products, and C(n,k).

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes each norm and matrix-product sum range over all valid finite indices.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched exponentiation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes squares in vector norms and natural powers n^p and k^q in C(n,k).

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entries in alpha is the function type m -> n -> alpha.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes matrices as coordinate functions and supports all explicit finite-sum definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Natural-number powers in a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real numbers it interprets x^p in C(n,k) and x^2 in Euclidean norms.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical cast of a natural number into a type with NatCast.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It turns n and k into real numbers before polynomial evaluation and gamma_n(u).

dependency_coverage.name: Ne
dependency_coverage.meaning: Inequality a!=b, defined as the negation of a=b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D015 requires b!=0, which makes ||b||_2 positive and forces xExact!=0 from AxExact=b.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise addition of functions or vectors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets vector additions in residual and update models and restart equations.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The pointwise zero function or zero vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the zero vector used in the assumption b!=0.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive commutative monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports all finite real sums in norms, matrix products, and polynomial evaluation.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive group structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports negation, subtraction, and absolute value in the packaged definitions and assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural powers used in norms and polynomial evaluation.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical embedding of natural numbers into the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets n and k as real polynomial arguments and the factor n in gamma_n(u).

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: The lattice order structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports real absolute values in componentwise run and restart error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The nonnegative real square-root operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to sums of squares, it defines every Euclidean vector norm in D025.

dependency_coverage.name: abs
dependency_coverage.meaning: Absolute value, defined as max(a,-a) in an ordered additive group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in componentwise residual, update, and modified Gram-Schmidt error assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous-power adapter induced by a Pow instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes power expressions to ordinary real natural powers.

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual strict order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses n>0 in D015 and keyDimension>0 in D036.

dependency_coverage.name: Function.Bijective
dependency_coverage.meaning: A function is both injective and surjective.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to x -> Ax, it is an implicit run-validity assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.frobeniusNormedRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: The normed-ring structure on square matrices whose norm is the Frobenius norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the matrix norms used by D032 and hence eta and kappa_F.

dependency_coverage.name: Norm.norm
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the norm function from a Norm instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It evaluates the Frobenius norm structures used in D032 and D044.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedRing.toNorm
dependency_coverage.meaning: The norm structure contained in a normed ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It exposes the Frobenius norm from the square-matrix normed-ring instance.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instRCLike
dependency_coverage.meaning: The RCLike structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits construction of the Frobenius normed-ring instance for real matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqFin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Decidable equality on Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is an implementation requirement for the square-matrix Frobenius normed-ring instance and adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.castSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: The inclusion Fin n -> Fin(n+1) preserving the underlying index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies the first k columns of basisNext with the columns of basis in restart validity.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.instOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interpretation of natural literals as finite indices when the finite type is nonempty.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies finite index 0 in restart formulas such as the first basis vector and initial work vector.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.succ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The successor inclusion Fin n -> Fin(n+1), mapping j to j+1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes the next basis vector and subdiagonal Hessenberg entry in restart normalization equations.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.add
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise addition of matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms perturbed Arnoldi and least-squares matrices inside restart records.

dependency_coverage.name: Max.max
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched maximum.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it underlies absolute value and therefore the componentwise error assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instNeZeroSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that n+1 is nonzero for every natural n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits literal finite index 0 in Fin(n+1) restart structures.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMax
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual maximum operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives absolute value its standard real meaning in nested error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: instLENat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual non-strict order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses keyDimension<=n and q<=j restrictions in restart-level formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: instNeZeroNatHAdd_1
dependency_coverage.meaning: If m is nonzero, then n+m is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies nonemptiness proofs for finite index types whose size is expressed as a natural sum.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It binds the unit-vector witness in D043; that witness remains internal to restart validity and is absent from the conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.cases
dependency_coverage.meaning: Case analysis on Fin(k+1), separating index 0 from successor indices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the first-column-versus-remaining-columns behavior of D039 and D040.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.frobeniusNormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The normed additive commutative group structure giving rectangular matrices their Frobenius norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the rectangular matrix norms used in restart-level Arnoldi and correction bounds.

binders: n is universally quantified, implicitly, over the natural numbers.
run is universally quantified over LocalDef001 n, so it ranges only over n-dimensional run packages satisfying the constructor requirements of D015 and the nested restart requirements of D026.
The supplied argument hLambda is a proof indexed by every natural iteration i.
Each of the two conjunctive conclusions separately quantifies over every natural iteration i.
hypotheses: The visible run constructor supplies n>0; matrices A,Ainv in R^(n by n); vectors b,xExact in R^n; sequences xHat_i, residualHat_i, correctionHat_i, residualError_i, and updateError_i in R^n; positive reals uHigh and uLow; a nonnegative-coefficient bivariate polynomial C; and one restart record per iteration.
The run assumptions include b!=0, bijectivity of x -> Ax, Ainv(Az)=z and A(Ainv z)=z for every z, and A xExact=b.

For every i, residualHat_i=b-A xHat_i+residualError_i. For every coordinate j, |residualError_i,j| <= gamma_n(uHigh)(|b_j|+(|A||xHat_i|)_j), where gamma_n(u)=n*u/(1-n*u), absolute values are entrywise, and the matrix-vector product is the usual finite sum.
For every i, xHat_(i+1)=xHat_i+correctionHat_i+updateError_i. For every coordinate j, |updateError_i,j| <= uHigh |xHat_(i+1),j|.

Writing k_i for the keyDimension of restart_i, the visible restart constructor requires 0<k_i<=n and packages Arnoldi and modified Gram-Schmidt data. Its displayed equations include P=A V+E_A; agreement of V with the first k_i columns of an extended basis; projection, update, and normalization recurrences; and their stated uLow- or gamma_n(uLow)-scaled error bounds.

The visible restart constructor also packages a residual cast residualLow=residualHat_i+residualCastError with ||residualCastError||_2 <= uLow||residualHat_i||_2; residualNorm=||residualLow||_2; residualLow=residualNorm times the first extended-basis vector; an Arnoldi product bound; a perturbed Euclidean least-squares minimizer; columnwise least-squares perturbation bounds; and correctionHat_i=V y+correctionFormationError with ||correctionFormationError||_2 <= epsilonX||V||_F||y||_2.

The visible restart assumptions require nonnegative epsilonC, epsilonB, epsilonLS, and epsilonX; epsilonB=uLow; nonnegative product, least-squares, and correction weights; epsilonC<=productWeight*uLow, epsilonLS<=leastSquaresWeight*uLow, and epsilonX<=correctionWeight*uLow; and a positive basisLowerGain satisfying basisLowerGain*||x||_2<=||Vx||_2 for every x. Additional restart assumptions after this point are omitted from the dossier.
For every i, ||updateError_i||_2/||xExact||_2 <= C(n,k_i)uHigh kappa_F, where kappa_F=||Ainv||_F||A||_F.
The explicit target hypothesis is that, for every natural i, 0 <= lambda_i and lambda_i < 1, where lambda_i=C(n,k_i)uLow kappa_F.
conclusions: For every natural i, eta(xHat_(i+1)) <= lambda_i eta(xHat_i)+C(n,k_i)uHigh.
For every natural i, E(xHat_(i+1)) <= lambda_i E(xHat_i)+C(n,k_i)uHigh kappa_F.
mathematical_definitions: Vectors are functions Fin n -> R, and square matrices are functions Fin n -> Fin n -> R.
||A||_F is the Frobenius norm, equivalently sqrt(sum_{r,s in Fin n} A_rs^2) for real matrices.
C(n,k)=sum_{p=0}^{degreeN} sum_{q=0}^{degreeK} c_pq n^p k^q, where every c_pq>=0 and natural arguments are cast to reals.
k_i is the keyDimension field of run.restart i.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every valid n-dimensional run, if every iteration-dependent factor lambda_i=C(n,k_i)uLow||Ainv||_F||A||_F lies in the half-open interval [0,1), then at every natural iteration the next normalized residual is at most lambda_i times the current normalized residual plus C(n,k_i)uHigh, and simultaneously the next relative forward error is at most lambda_i times the current relative forward error plus C(n,k_i)uHigh||Ainv||_F||A||_F.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The proposition is conditional on the existence of a LocalDef001 n inhabitant. The displayed run constructor requires n>0, so the universal statement is vacuous at n=0 if that is the only constructor.
The implication is vacuous for any run that does not satisfy lambda_i<1 for every natural i. No theorem inside this declaration establishes that strict inequality.

The hypothesis quantifies over an infinite sequence of iterations. There is no stopping index, finite iteration count, termination assertion, or existence assertion for an algorithm producing such a run.
The two conclusions are one-step recurrences only. They do not assert convergence to zero, a uniform contraction factor below one, or a closed-form multi-step bound; lambda_i may vary with i.
The vector norm is exactly the Euclidean norm and the matrix norm is exactly the Frobenius norm, not the spectral norm. Consequently kappa_F is the product of Frobenius norms.

Lean real division is total and would assign a value even at a zero denominator. For a run made by D015, however, b!=0 makes the normalized-residual denominator positive, and AxExact=b forces xExact!=0, making the forward-error denominator positive.
No assumption n*uHigh<1 or n*uLow<1 is displayed for gamma_n(u)=n*u/(1-n*u). Thus its denominator may be zero or negative under Lean's total real-division semantics.

The dimension factor C has nonnegative coefficients, and the visible restart constructor gives 1<=k_i<=n. Together with uLow>0 and nonnegative norms, these data already imply lambda_i>=0, although nonnegativity is also explicitly assumed.

The proposition concerns only run records satisfying extensive exact equations and error inequalities. It does not independently establish that actual floating-point executions satisfy those packaged assumptions.
